scientific_limitations: The complete spectrum theorem concerns finite reduced commutative nonfields; the single-field graph is edgeless and is treated separately.
No conclusion is asserted for nonreduced or infinite rings, Laplacian spectra, or general unweighted Cayley graphs.
Potential equivalent formulas in association-scheme treatments and a withdrawn/restructured revision of the motivating preprint are residual bibliography risks.
title: Complete adjacency spectrum of the bipartite zero-divisor–unit graph of finite reduced rings
